complete_examples.text: A modi-fied periodogram method was applied to analyze the measured track irregularity data of the railway and a unified PSD fitting formula that can characterize the basic irregularity characteristics of the railway was proposed to obtain the characteristic parameters of average PSD of the railway.
采用修正的周期图法分析青藏线的实测轨道不平顺数据,提出能够表征青藏线不平顺特征的统一谱密度函数拟合公式,得到了青藏线轨道平均谱的特征参数。
